name: Rust (Paradox)
author: support@pterodactyl.io
description: Rust dedicated server. Supports the public and staging branches, Oxide or Carbon with the matching build for each branch, and automatic Discord, RustEdit and ChaosCode downloads.
startup: ./RustDedicated -batchmode +server.port {{SERVER_PORT}} +server.queryport {{QUERY_PORT}} +server.identity \"{{SERVER_IDENTITY}}\" +rcon.port {{RCON_PORT}} +rcon.web true +rcon.password \"{{RCON_PASS}}\" +server.hostname \"{{HOSTNAME}}\" +server.level \"{{LEVEL}}\" +server.description \"{{DESCRIPTION}}\" +server.url \"{{SERVER_URL}}\" +server.headerimage \"{{SERVER_IMG}}\" +server.logoimage \"{{SERVER_LOGO}}\" +server.maxplayers {{MAX_PLAYERS}} +server.saveinterval {{SAVEINTERVAL}} +app.port {{APP_PORT}} +fps.limit {{FPS_LIMIT}} $( [ "${REQUIRE_TPM_SECURE_BOOT}" = "1" ] && printf %s "+server.useServerWideRequiredSystemConfig true" ) $( [ -n "${APP_PUBLIC_IP}" ] && printf %s "+app.publicip ${APP_PUBLIC_IP}" ) $( [ -n "${SERVER_TAGS}" ] && printf %s "+server.tags \"${SERVER_TAGS}\"" ) $( [ -n "${GAMEMODE}" ] && printf %s "+server.gamemode ${GAMEMODE}" ) $( [ -z "${MAP_URL}" ] && printf %s "+server.worldsize \"{{WORLD_SIZE}}\" +server.seed \"{{WORLD_SEED}}\"" || printf %s "+server.levelurl \"{{MAP_URL}}\"" ) {{ADDITIONAL_ARGS}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# SteamCMD install for Rust. Server files: /mnt/server
SRCDS_APPID=258550

cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/steamapps
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise, even as root. Ownership is fixed after install.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

# Warm up SteamCMD first; its first run often fails with "Missing configuration".
./steamcmd.sh +login anonymous +quit || true

# Always name the branch. Without -beta, SteamCMD stays on the last beta used.
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} -beta "${BRANCH:-public}" validate +quit

mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32 /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

# Remember the installed branch so the first start does not re-validate.
printf 'branch=%s\n' "${BRANCH:-public}" > /mnt/server/.egg_state
echo "Install complete."

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name of your server in the public server list.

variables.name: Description
variables.description: The description under your server title. Commonly used for rules & info. Use \n for newlines.

variables.name: URL
variables.description: The URL for your server. This is what comes up when clicking the "Visit Website" button.

variables.name: Server Image
variables.description: The header image for the top of your server listing.

variables.name: Server Logo
variables.description: The circular server logo for the Rust+ app.

variables.name: Server Tags
variables.description: Comma-separated server browser tags with no spaces, for example: weekly,NA,vanilla. Full list: https://wiki.facepunch.com/rust/server-browser-tags. Leave blank for none.

variables.name: Gamemode
variables.description: Rust gamemode: vanilla, survival, softcore, hardcore, weapontest or primitive. Leave blank for the game default.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: The maximum amount of players allowed in the server at once.

variables.name: FPS Limit
variables.description: Server frame cap (+fps.limit). Rust default is 256. A value in server/<identity>/cfg/serverauto.cfg or set by a plugin can override this.

variables.name: Level
variables.description: The world file for Rust to use.

variables.name: World Size
variables.description: The world size for a procedural map.

variables.name: World Seed
variables.description: The seed for a procedural map.

variables.name: Custom Map URL
variables.description: Overwrites the map with the one from the direct download URL. Invalid URLs will cause the server to crash.

variables.name: Save Interval
variables.description: Sets the server’s auto-save interval in seconds.

variables.name: Server Identity
variables.description: Folder under server/ that holds the save, config and player data. Changing it starts a fresh save.

variables.name: Additional Arguments
variables.description: Extra startup convars. Every convar must start with a +, for example: +server.pve true. Values without a + are ignored by the server.

variables.name: Branch
variables.description: Rust game branch: public (normal) or staging (Facepunch test branch). Oxide and Carbon are installed in the matching build. Changing branch re-validates the game on the next start. Saves may not carry over between branches.

variables.name: Modding Framework
variables.description: vanilla, oxide or carbon. Switching re-validates the game on the next start and removes the old framework's DLLs. Switching between oxide and carbon copies plugins, configs and data across once; the old folder is kept.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Update the game through SteamCMD on every start. 1 = on, 0 = off.

variables.name: Validate Game Files
variables.description: Run a full SteamCMD validate on every start. Slower. 1 = on, 0 = off.

variables.name: Framework Update
variables.description: Download the latest Oxide/Carbon on every start. 1 = on, 0 = keep the installed version. On wipe day Oxide can be released before or after the Rust update; if the server crashes after a wipe, set this to 0 until both match.

variables.name: Discord Extension
variables.description: Oxide.Ext.Discord. 1 = install and keep updated, 0 = remove (also removes a copy you installed by hand). Needs oxide or carbon.

variables.name: RustEdit Extension
variables.description: Oxide.Ext.RustEdit, needed by many RustEdit custom maps. 1 = install and keep updated, 0 = remove (also removes a copy you installed by hand). Needs oxide or carbon.

variables.name: ChaosCode Extension
variables.description: Oxide.Ext.Chaos, used by ChaosCode plugins. 1 = install and keep updated, 0 = remove (also removes a copy you installed by hand). Needs oxide or carbon.

variables.name: Require TPM + Secure Boot
variables.description: Only allow players whose PC has TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot on. Marks the server as Secure in the server list. 1 = on, 0 = off.

variables.name: Log File
variables.description: Also write the server log to logs/<date>.log. While on, the console only shows output after RCON connects. 1 = on, 0 = off.

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: Server Query Port. Can't be the same as Game's primary port.

variables.name: RCON Port
variables.description: Port for RCON connections.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: RCON access password. Letters, numbers, dot, dash and underscore only.

variables.name: App Port
variables.description: Port for the Rust+ App. -1 to disable.

variables.name: App Public IP
variables.description: Public IP for the Rust+ app. Leave blank unless you have read https://wiki.facepunch.com/rust/rust-companion-server
